claim_text: Home contents insurance claim submitted on 18 March 2024 by Ms. Patricia Dunne for theft of high-value items including luxury electronics (two MacBook Pro laptops, a 65-inch OLED television) and jewellery (estimated value £12,400). This is the third claim submitted by Ms. Dunne in the past six months — previous claims involved water damage (October 2023) and an earlier theft (January 2024). No witnesses to the alleged break-in were identified. The incident date reported is 15 March 2024, however the submitted purchase receipts for the electronics are dated after the reported theft date, which is inconsistent. Furthermore, the claimant's neighbour, contacted as part of routine verification, disputes the account of events and states they were home all day and noticed nothing unusual. The property shows no signs of forced entry in the loss adjuster's photographs. Claimant has been uncooperative during the follow-up interview.
